devNoteRules: capitalRoads = who handles parking (KRESZ stopping/waiting) enforcement on capital-managed roads in that district: fori | district | both (district on the listed districtActsOn sections, FÖRI elsewhere) | unknown. Resolver (SPEC 4.2): FÖRI is primary on every capital road unless the pin's road section is listed in districtActsOn.
